qt: to the Commission Rima Hassan (The Left), Mimmo Lucano (The Left), Gaetano Pedulla' (The Left), Danilo Della Valle (The Left), Anthony Smith (The Left), Damien Carême (The Left), Rudi Kennes (The Left), Merja Kyllönen (The Left), Chloé Ridel (S&D), Catarina Martins (The Left), Jussi Saramo (The Left), Vicent Marzà Ibáñez (Verts/ALE), Manon Aubry (The Left), Leila Chaibi (The Left), Tineke Strik (Verts/ALE), Martin Günther (The Left), Mounir Satouri (Verts/ALE), Ufuk Kâhya (Verts/ALE), Marc Botenga (The Left), Lynn Boylan (The Left), Ilaria Salis (The Left), Marina Mesure (The Left), Ana Miranda Paz (Verts/ALE), Emma Fourreau (The Left), Pernando Barrena Arza (The Left), Aodhán Ó Ríordáin (S&D), Leoluca Orlando (Verts/ALE), Cecilia Strada (S&D), Matjaž Nemec (S&D), Per Clausen (The Left) Subject:

On 9 October 2026, the United States placed the International Criminal Court (ICC) on the Office of Foreign Assets Control’s sanctions list, having already targeted several judges and officials. These sanctions threaten the Court’s operations, financial transactions, service providers and staff, undermining its independence and investigations, such as those focused on crimes committed in Palestine. At the Foreign Affairs Council on 12 October 2026, Belgium and the Netherlands raised this issue. Kaja Kallas stated that the EU had several options to protect the ICC, without specifying them. Against this background: 1.
What concrete measures is the Commission considering to urgently protect the ICC, its staff and service providers from US sanctions, and when will it implement them?

In its reply to Written Question E-000718/2026) of 28 May 20261, the Commission stated it was considering revising the annex to Council Regulation (EC) No 2271/96 (the ‘Blocking Statute’)2 to explicitly include US sanctions against the ICC. What progress has been made since?

What guarantees will the Commission provide to European companies and financial institutions to maintain their relations with the ICC without suffering the extraterritorial effects of these sanctions?
